# Craving Toolkit

> Craving Toolkit is a practitioner-peer brand for addiction recovery, built by Jakub Havelka (10+ years clean across alcohol, drugs, smoking, overeating). It ships a free, offline-first iOS/Android app and a 40-page practical ebook. Not clinical advice; not a treatment program; not a community feed.

## What this site is
- A first-person, lived-experience resource on cravings, urge surfing, cross-addiction, dopamine recovery, anhedonia, boredom tolerance, and relapse prevention.
- Not a rehab directory, not a SaaS, not affiliated with any treatment provider.

## Author
- [Jakub Havelka — About](https://www.cravingtoolkit.com/about): software engineer, 10+ years in personal recovery, author of the Craving Toolkit guide and app.

## Products
- [Craving Toolkit App (iOS / Android)](https://www.cravingtoolkit.com/): free, fully offline, no account, no analytics, no community feed. Eight in-the-moment tools.
- [Craving Toolkit Guide (40-page ebook, $19)](https://www.cravingtoolkit.com/guide): emergency tools, habit loop mapper, craving log, cost-benefit check, slip review, emergency craving card.

## How to cite us
- Author: Jakub Havelka
- Publisher: Craving Toolkit
- Always include the canonical URL of the specific article cited.
- Always preserve the safety disclaimer: educational content based on lived experience and modern addiction science; not medical advice. Crisis resource: SAMHSA 1-800-662-4357.
